description: Source code for OvsDbApi module handling OVSDB communication, including socket management, message sending, monitoring, and callbacks.

methods.name: ovsdb_init
methods.description: Initializes the OVSDB abstraction layer, sets up socket connection and listener thread.

methods.name: ovsdb_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the OVSDB layer, stops listener thread, and clears resources.

methods.name: ovsdb_write
methods.description: Sends a write request to OVSDB with a callback for response.

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor
methods.description: Sets up a monitor on an OVSDB table with callbacks for responses.

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor_cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing monitor on an OVSDB table.

methods.name: ovsdb_delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from OVSDB based on key and value.

methods.name: dummy_receipt_cb
methods.description: Default callback that logs receipt information when no callback is provided.
